Event definition: first record of the 157th Mountain Division, the same formation under a new designation (lineage UL021 from GER-RES-157D); the row on the predecessor is C8656. Location: Grenoble, Isère (place PL3902) with a precision of 50 km; no place is given for 1 September; the last documented area of the predecessor (the western Alps, C8656) is used.
